notes.title: Update: Gamepad Vibration, Weapon Skill Improvements, Card List Popup
notes.content:
Thank you for playing BATTLE SHADOW ARENA!
To provide a better gameplay experience, we have applied the following updates:

Gamepad Vibration Added
The gamepad now vibrates when taking damage or using Battle Cards during combat.

Weapon Active Skill Improvements
Several weapon active skills have been adjusted to make it easier to hit enemies.

Dual Blades: Wind 10, 11, 12 / Earth 11

Spear: Water 8, 10, 11 / Wind 6, 10 / Earth 10 / Fire 10, 12

Greatsword: Water 10, 12 / Wind 3, 5, 10, 11, 12 / Earth 5, 6, 8, 10, 11 / Fire 3, 4, 6, 8, 10

Battle Card List Popup
A popup UI has been added that allows you to view the entire Battle Card list after combat in the card selection map.

We will continue to do our best to deliver a more complete game.
Thank you sincerely for playing!

notes.title: Update: New Practice Map, Performance Optimization, and Growth Improvements
notes.content:
Thank you for playing BATTLE SHADOW ARENA!
We’ve applied the following updates to provide a better gameplay experience.

Practice Map Added
A dedicated practice map has been added to help new players learn the controls.
(Accessible from the Battle menu)

In-Combat Guide Display Added
You can now view the control guide from the pause menu during battle.

Skill Effect Optimization
Some skill effects that were causing frame drops have been optimized to improve performance.

Battle Menu UI Update
Improved controller navigation responsiveness and revised the stage reset text to be more intuitive.

Stat Reset Cost Greatly Reduced
To encourage experimenting with various builds, the stat reset cost has been reduced from 20% to 3%.

Increased Healing Card Speed
The usage speed of healing-type battle cards has been increased, making recovery easier.

We’ll continue working hard to deliver a more polished and enjoyable experience.
Thank you again for playing!

notes.title: Update: AI Improvements, Balance Adjustments, and Effect Tweaks
notes.content:
Thank you for playing BATTLE SHADOW ARENA!

To provide a fairer and more immersive combat experience, we've applied the following balance and system updates:

Adjusted late-game boss attack tempo to allow more counterattack opportunities

Significantly reduced enemy stat scaling based on stage and level

(applies from stage 2-2 after resetting the stage)

Fixed a bug where some card skills were dealing excessively high damage

Tweaked the brightness of certain skill effects to reduce visual fatigue

We’ll continue improving the gameplay experience.
Thank you for your feedback and support!

notes.title: Demo Update: UI Improvements, Localization Fixes & Lighting Enhancements
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the BATTLE SHADOW ARENA demo!

We've released a small update focused on improving clarity and visibility:

* Improved visibility of action button guide in the tutorial screen
* Corrected some unnatural translations for smoother localization
* Enhanced overall lighting in the underground map to improve visibility and atmosphere

Thank you for all your support and feedback!

notes.title: Demo Update: Combat Sound, Tooltips, UI Fixes
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the BATTLE SHADOW ARENA demo!

We've released a small update to improve the gameplay experience:

- Fixed gamepad focus issue in the Active Skill menu  
- Added tooltip in the Battle menu to display selected active/passive skills  
- Adjusted combat sound volume  
- Renamed some menu labels

Thank you for all the feedback and support.
